In [[cosmology]], two objects that have no relative motions to each other except from [[cosmic expansion]] are said to be '''comoving'''.

== Modelling in [[comoving coordinates]] ==

If points $A,B$ in space have coordinates $(r(t),\theta(t),\phi(t)),\, (r'(t),\theta'(t),\phi'(t))$, then

$$
\forall t:
\begin{cases}
r(t)-r'(t) = r(t_0)-r'(t_0) \\
\theta(t)-\theta'(t) = \theta(t_0)-\theta'(t_0) \\
\phi(t)-\phi'(t) = \phi(t_0)-\phi'(t_0)
\end{cases}
$$
